name: coincident-sphere-union
why: A ball unioned with itself turned a quarter about X. The fuse was always exact (4188.79 mm³, one face), but the copy's seam stayed on that face as an internal wire and BRepMesh meshed only the region it cut off: a watertight 727.70 mm³ fragment, then a refusal from the worker's volume backstop. Internal edges are now dropped after the unify pass, and the recorded mesh is exactly what plain sphere(10) meshes to: 4182.71 mm³ in 10106 triangles, 20 mm each way. Goes red if the seam comes back, as a volume a fifth of this or as the backstop's refusal. docs/GOTCHAS.md has the table.
